integrity: Self-contained algebraic proof of the all-n formulas, with standalone executable cross-checks. No independent external audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: All claims concern labelled simple gear graphs, synchronous open-neighborhood parity over F2, and exact finite-state dynamics. Other fields, update schemes and graph classes are outside scope; possible unindexed prior equivalents remain a historical risk.
title: Binary gear-graph parity dynamics: short-ring Jordan fusion and an exact recurrence census
